entries.18d7fba930e47644: It has formulated the “2030 Medium-Term Management Strategy” and sets three pillars of strategy: accelerating growth through enhanced brand value, evolving global operations, and creating sustainable value. entries.5039e1f2dc9cc6c9: This business manufactures and sells cosmetics and cosmetic tools by brand category, such as prestige and fragrance, in Europe, the Middle East and Africa. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥141,129 million, accounting for 14.5% of consolidated revenue; this was a 6.4% increase year on year. Although 'Drunk Elephant' continued to struggle, fragrances such as 'Zadig&Voltaire' and 'narciso rodriguez', which launched new products, grew strongly. The main companies include Shiseido Europe S.A., Shiseido International France S.A.S., Shiseido (Russia) LLC., Shiseido Italia S.p.A., Shiseido Deutschland GmbH and Beauté Prestige International S.A.S.

entries.57958d7e40e3febc: Revenue for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥969,992 million, down 2.1% from ¥990,586 million in the previous year. Declining consumption, mainly in the first half, in the China Travel Retail Business and the struggles of “Drunk Elephant” in the Americas Business weighed on results, but growth in focus brands led to positive growth in the second half. Revenue from external customers was largest for the China Travel Retail Business at ¥342,244 million (35.3% of consolidated), followed by the Japan Business at ¥295,343 million (30.4%), the Europe Business at ¥141,129 million (14.5%), the Americas Business at ¥106,584 million (11.0%), the Asia Pacific Business at ¥73,290 million (7.6%), and Other at ¥11,399 million (1.2%).

entries.b0d1c0e92ab275e5: This business manufactures and sells cosmetics and cosmetic tools by brand category, such as prestige, fragrance and cosmetics, in the Asia and Oceania region excluding Japan and China. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥73,290 million, accounting for 7.6% of consolidated revenue; this was a 2.3% increase year on year. While markets shrank in Taiwan and elsewhere, Southeast Asia centered on Thailand and South Korea drove growth, and priority brands centered on Clé de Peau Beauté, SHISEIDO and Elixir grew. The main companies include Shiseido Asia Pacific Pte. Ltd. and Taiwan Shiseidō Kōfun Yūgen Kōshi.

entries.b1319e5a82f4d812: This business manufactures and sells cosmetics and cosmetic tools by brand category, such as prestige, fragrance and cosmetics, in China and in duty-free areas around the world (airports, city duty-free shops, etc.). Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥342,244 million, accounting for 35.3% of consolidated revenue and the largest of the reportable segments. This was a 4.3% decrease from the previous year; a decline in consumption linked to deteriorating sentiment weighed on results, although a recovery was seen in the second half of the year. In China, Clé de Peau Beauté and NARS led growth, and e-commerce grew strongly during 'Double Eleven', China's largest e-commerce event. In travel retail, the shift to a business centered on travelers progressed well, but weak spending by Chinese travelers in China and South Korea continued, and revenue declined. From the fiscal year ended December 2025, this category combines the former 'China Business' and 'Travel Retail Business' into one. The main companies are Shiseido (China) Investment Co., Ltd., Shiseido Reigen Keshōhin Yūgen Kōshi, Shiseido Hong Kong Co., Ltd., Shiseidō Shōbō (Shanghai) Yūgen Kōshi and Shiseido Travel Retail Asia Pacific Pte. Ltd., among others.

entries.c64a135d6c653472: This business sells cosmetics and cosmetic tools by brand category, such as prestige, fragrance and premium, in Japan, and conducts other activities including the healthcare business (sales of beauty foods and over-the-counter drugs). Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥295,343 million, accounting for 30.4% of consolidated revenue; this was a 0.4% increase year on year. Growth came from core brands centered on SHISEIDO and Elixir, with contributions from new products incorporating the latest technology. Meanwhile, although the number of foreign visitors to Japan reached a record high for the full year, purchasing motivation fell owing to changes in travelers' spending behavior and a narrowing of the price gap between Japan and overseas, and the growth of inbound consumption slowed. From the fiscal year ended December 2025, the results of IPSA Co., Ltd.'s domestic sales function, previously recorded under 'Other', and the sales function for beauty foods and other products in the healthcare business are included in this category (prior-year figures are also restated under the new category). The main companies are Shiseido Japan Co., Ltd., Shiseido Biyōshitsu Kabushiki Kaisha, Shiseido Fitit Kabushiki Kaisha and Shiseido International Co., Ltd., among others.

entries.dddd00723e5a8190: Founded in 1872, the company has aimed to “contribute to customers and society through ‘beauty and health’,” and its head office is in Ginza, Chuo-ku, Tokyo. Its corporate mission is “BEAUTY INNOVATIONS FOR A BETTER WORLD (Bringing Better Worlds with the Power of Beauty).” The company, together with 64 subsidiaries and 3 associates, forms a group that conducts business in five reportable segments—Japan, China Travel Retail, Asia Pacific, Americas, and Europe—and in Other, which is not included in the reportable segments. The accounting standard is International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS).
entries.e02f7f17aa8184e5: The loss attributable to owners of the parent for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥40,680 million, widening from a loss of ¥10,813 million in the previous year. This reflected the recording of goodwill impairment losses as a result of an impairment test conducted following declining profitability in the Americas Business. In the current period, it completed the main structural reform actions and worked to improve profitability under the “Action Plan 2025-2026,” formulated in November 2024.

entries.f78c51b12c869a09: Its main business is the sale of cosmetics, cosmetic tools, beauty foods, and pharmaceuticals, and it also conducts research and services related to each business. In the Healthcare Business within the Japan Business, beauty foods and over-the-counter pharmaceuticals are sold, and cosmetics are delivered under brands such as “SHISEIDO,” “Elixir,” “Clé de Peau Beauté,” and “NARS.” In Europe, the fragrance brands “Zadig&Voltaire” and “narciso rodriguez” have also grown. Its research and development base, the Research Center (Global Innovation Center), is located in Nishi-ku, Yokohama, Kanagawa Prefecture, and under its own R&D philosophy, “DYNAMIC HARMONY,” it is pursuing selection and concentration in research.
entries.fed09073b5e7421f: Revenue is generated in each of the Japan, China Travel Retail, Europe, Americas, and Asia Pacific segments. In Japan, inbound consumption (shopping by foreign visitors to Japan) has also been added; in China, e-commerce is growing; and travel retail sells cosmetics and fragrances at airports, downtown duty-free shops, and similar outlets, shifting to a business centered on travelers. No specific external customer accounts for 10% or more of revenue.
